scope.statement: For the exact seven-label PR104 source, the coupled path c=t, z=(1,11/5-t) is a same-cardinality strict-sub-D competitor for every 0<t<=1/10, with all 21 lower and upper pair constraints checked.
scope.domain: Two adjacent unit rhombi v_(i,j)=i(1,0)+j(c,s), i=0,1,2 and j=0,1, plus z=(1+u,11/5+v); specialize u=0, v=-t, c=t, s=sqrt(1-t^2), 0<t<=1/10, retaining all seven labels and checking all unordered pairs.
scope.limitations: This is a finite exact result for the PR104 fixture and proves that seven-label source is nonglobal. It proves no extraction of the motion from a canonical C-II source, universal minimizer statement, asymptotic result, or Level I closure.

result: The full-source diameter squared along the path is 1+(11/5-t)^2<146/25, with exactly seven unit contacts and a triangle-free ladder graph. At t=1/10 the diameter squared is 541/100.
remaining_questions: Derive a nonzero isolate displacement and common train shear satisfying every full-source lower and upper pair bound from a canonical C-II source, or prove a source-specific obstruction to such extraction.
